ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, LDGCRM_Email__c, LDGCRM_External_ID__c, LDGCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Team_Name__c, LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c, LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c, LDGCRM_contact__r.Name, LDGCRM_Application__r.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM LDGCRM_Application_Contact__c WHERE LDGCRM_Email__c = :email ORDER BY Name DESC
ApiNamedQuery.description: Login.gov Partnership Portal Integration. Application Contacts for one email address. Returns MANY rows, not one - the same person appears once per Application they are on.

apiNamedQueryParameters.description: The contact email address to match exactly.
